seo.title: Services — API guidance & expertise
seo.description: Consulting, integration and support from the Meecrogate team: our experts stay with you from proof of concept to production rollout of your sovereign API platform.

title: Integration service
subtitle: Our team works alongside you to fit Meecrogate to your context, so the platform lands cleanly on your infrastructure.

diagnostic.title: Assessment of what you already run:
diagnostic.description: We review your technical environment, architecture, API flows and integration constraints.

targetArchitecture.title: Proposed target architecture:
targetArchitecture.description: We define an architecture suited to your information system, so Meecrogate can be adopted gradually and safely.

deployment.title: Tailored deployment:
deployment.description: We support installation in your environments (cloud, on-premise or hybrid) and adapt configurations and orchestrations to your needs.

training.title: Knowledge transfer:
training.description: Training and best practices so your teams are productive quickly.

support.title: Enhanced support:
support.description: A dedicated support channel throughout the migration and integration project.
